prioritization_note: P0 must form a runnable vertical slice within 1-2 days. P1 extends coverage. P2 hardens/polishes.

backlog.title: Snapshot & Contract Registry (REAL)
backlog.description: CLI subcommand to register a project snapshot: enumerate allowed files, compute SHA-256, load snapshot_verification.json (VERIFIED), record run contract from execution_contract.json.
backlog.acceptance: Given polar-baseline snapshot, produces registry_record.json with 13 allowed-file hashes matching VERIFIED; contract_record.json populated; trace appended.
risks: large excluded files not enumerated (must skip)

backlog.title: Evidence Collector (REAL)
backlog.description: Load repository_map/evidence_index/evidence_gaps; scan allowed files to re-confirm strong evidence refs; mark missing evidence; never read excluded data.
backlog.acceptance: Produces collected_evidence.json with 22 evidence items (17 strong/2 weak/3 missing) and 10 gaps mapped to states; excluded-data reads = 0.

backlog.title: Diagnosis Engine (REAL, rule-based)
backlog.description: Turn evidence into diagnostic candidates. Every candidate MUST cite evidence_id; missing evidence -> UNKNOWN/BLOCKED.
backlog.acceptance: diagnosis_candidates.json: all 10 gaps represented as BLOCKED/UNKNOWN (none asserted as fact); every candidate has >=1 evidence_id.
risks: temptation to guess -> guarded by schema validation

backlog.title: Approval Gate (REAL policy + SIMULATED triggers)
backlog.description: Classify actions per approval_policy.json; read-only auto-run; high-risk emit approval request with dry-run; forbidden refuse. In demo, install/download/train use SIMULATED adapter.
backlog.acceptance: approval_requests.json + decisions.json; reject/timeout are first-class; forbidden actions refused even if approved; no real network/install in demo.

backlog.title: Action Executor (MIXED: real benign + simulated risky)
backlog.description: Dry-run-first; command allowlist; workdir boundary; timeout; output truncation + redaction. Benign file/hash ops real; install/download/train simulated.
backlog.acceptance: execution_result.json with dry_run/status; forbidden commands blocked; outputs truncated/redacted; workdir respected.

backlog.title: Verification Closer (REAL)
backlog.description: Post-action checks: exit code, artifact existence, hash match. Only PASSED closes incident; FAILED/PARTIAL/NOT_VERIFIED keeps BLOCKED.
backlog.acceptance: verification_result.json; closure rule enforced (no closure without PASSED unless explicit REJECTED/UNVERIFIED).

backlog.title: Append-only Trace Log (REAL)
backlog.description: Hash-chained append-only trace capturing every entity transition with timestamp + prev_hash.
backlog.acceptance: trace.log append-only; integrity check passes; no entry modified/deleted.

backlog.title: Polar-baseline Demo Runbook Execution
backlog.description: Drive demo: register snapshot -> collect evidence -> surface 10 gaps as BLOCKED/UNKNOWN -> approval loop on install/download/calibration -> verification closure.
backlog.acceptance: End-to-end vertical slice runs in demo mode within 1-2 days; demonstrates missing-evidence detection + approval closure; no fabricated faults; no excluded-data reads.

backlog.title: Configurable command allowlist + workdir policies
backlog.description: External policy file (YAML/JSON) for allowlist, timeout defaults, redaction patterns, output limits.
backlog.acceptance: Policy changes without code change; invalid policy rejected.

backlog.title: Real (non-simulated) executor for safe commands
backlog.description: Enable REAL execution for approved benign commands (e.g., create requirements.txt from evidence) while keeping risky ops simulated/locked.
backlog.acceptance: Approved benign action executes and verifies; risky actions still blocked/simulated.
risks: accidental real execution of risky op

backlog.title: Evidence-reference integrity validation
backlog.description: Schema check that every hypothesis/evidence ref resolves to an existing file/line/cell; dangling refs reported.
backlog.acceptance: Dangling evidence refs detected and surfaced; zero silent refs.

backlog.title: Multi-project registry + searchable trace
backlog.description: Support multiple project snapshots; query trace/incidents by project/evidence/state.
backlog.acceptance: Query returns correct incident/evidence/approval history per project.

backlog.title: Redaction & secrets scanner hardening
backlog.description: Improve redaction rules; scan outputs for accidental key/secret leakage.
backlog.acceptance: Redaction tests pass; no secrets in trace/outputs.

backlog.title: Trace integrity + audit export
backlog.description: Export audit bundle (registry, evidence, approvals, actions, verification, trace) for external review; verify hash chain.

vertical_slice_note: P0-01..P0-08 together form the 1-2 day runnable vertical slice: registry -> evidence -> diagnosis -> approval -> action(demo) -> verification -> trace, demonstrated on polar-baseline.
risk_summary: Security: forbidden actions must be refused even if approved (P0-04/05 guard)
Integrity: evidence refs must resolve; no guessing (P0-03/P1-03)
Safety: demo must not fabricate faults or read excluded data (P0-08 guard)
Reproducibility: hashes + trace chain must hold (P0-01/P0-07)
